thread:
oncall-bot: Paging: High 5xx rate observed from glasgow1 egress (inference-serving) — impact: ~40-60% requests failing, starting 2024-06-03 09:12 UTC. Pager priority: P1.

maya: I’m on it. seeing spikes on the egress gateway metrics, tcp resets and 502s. pulling logs now.

raj: I can triage KV caching layer — will check for KVCACHE pressure. tagging kevin for routing changes if needed.

maya: logs: `curl -s http://metrics.local/glasgow1/egress | jq '.errors.rate'` ~= 0.48. Also `gateway-proxy` pods in glasgow1 showing intermittent connection refused to upstream egress peer (10.10.45.2).

kevin: Confirmed from net metrics: egress NAT pool exhaustion + intermittent peering flaps to our partner AS. Why it's only glasgow1: peer path from glasgow1 takes different egress nat IPs (secondary pool).

samira: Can we drain traffic off glasgow1 to lon1/eu-west2 as a temporary mitigation? Need rollout plan so we don't overload lon1.

raj: Suggest shifting 40% traffic immediately, then monitor. Runbook excerpt: 
```
# immediate routing change
redwood-route update --region glasgow1 --weight 60
redwood-route update --region lon1 --weight +40
```
Apply for 1 minute then check per-route qps/latency.

maya: doing the first shift now. running `redwood-route` from ops shell.

deploy-bot: Command executed by maya: `redwood-route update --region glasgow1 --weight 60` — OK.

maya: shifting +40% to lon1 completed. monitoring...

cassie: Heads up — customer comm drafts. If we need to notify impacted customers, I can push an advisory. Draft suggestion below: 
"We are investigating increased error rates for requests routed via our glasgow1 region. Our engineers are actively mitigating by rerouting traffic. You may see transient errors or increased latency; we will update within 30 minutes with additional details."

david: +1 to that copy, add recommended mitigation for customers: set client retry to jittered backoff, avoid long polling. Example snippet: `max_retries=3, backoff=200-800ms jitter`.

kevin: Early telemetry shows request error rate in glasgow1 dropped from 48% -> 18% after shift, and lon1 CPU increased ~12%. Still seeing occasional spikes on the glasgow1 gateway (connection refused events).

maya: running a second small shift: reduce glasgow1 to 30% and increase lon1 to 70% for now.

deploy-bot: Command executed by maya: `redwood-route update --region glasgow1 --weight 30` — OK.

maya: Monitoring 10m. latency in lon1 still within SLOs. glasgow1 errors <10% now.

raj: KVCACHE metrics show no pressure. I think primary issue is upstream peering flaps + NAT pool exhaustion as kevin noted.

kevin: I'm opening a ticket with the peering provider — routing team looped. Meanwhile request: can we increase glasgow1 NAT pool size for warm standby? That is an ops change but maybe quicker to request from infra.

samira: I'll take the oncall handoff at 09:45 UTC. maya — please summarize current state and post short status page update so customers see we’re actively mitigating.

maya: Status page draft (posting now): 
- Status: Partial degradation in glasgow1 for inference-serving (errors and higher latency)
- Impact: Some requests routed via glasgow1 may fail or experience increased latency.
- Mitigation: Traffic partially rerouted to lon1 and eu-west2; engineering investigating with peering provider.
- ETA for next update: 30 mins

deploy-bot: Status page updated by maya.

cassie: I'll prepare a targeted customer notification for accounts with pinned regions to glasgow1. Draft: 
"We are aware of increased errors for requests routed via glasgow1. We have rerouted a portion of traffic and are investigating. If you have traffic pinned to glasgow1, we recommend temporarily allowing cross-region failover to lon1 or eu-west2 while we resolve the underlying peering issue. Contact support if you need help."

david: Also add a line about rate limiting config: if any customers are near limits they may see 429s after reroute; include link to docs.

maya: Status update at 09:35 UTC: glasgow1 errors down to 6-9%, overall platform errors down to 1.2%. Still monitoring upstream peering.

kevin: Peering provider acknowledged packet loss on their glasgow1 peering node — they are rolling a fix. They requested we keep reduced traffic to glasgow1 for 1 hour while they validate.

samira: Taking over oncall now. maya — thanks for the handoff summary. I'll keep monitoring and coordinate with kevin on NAT pool increase request.

maya: handing off -> samira. Full notes: rerouted 70% to lon1, glasgow1 at 30%, status page updated, customer drafts in #support-drafts, peering provider engaged.

samira: Acknowledged. Next internal update at 10:15 UTC or sooner if status changes. Assigning follow-ups: 
- kevin: track peering provider fix and confirm when glasgow1 can be returned to normal weights.
- raj: verify KVCACHE and gateway pod restarts are not needed.
- cassie: send targeted customer advisory if provider ETA > 60m.

kevin: Provider reports fix deployed to glasgow1 peering node at 09:58 UTC, monitoring for packet loss. Requesting ramp test: move glasgow1 to 50% for 5 minutes and observe.

samira: Performing ramp to 50% for 5m now.

deploy-bot: Command executed by samira: `redwood-route update --region glasgow1 --weight 50` — OK.

samira: Post-ramp checks: glasgow1 errors stable <2%, no packet loss seen. lon1 within healthy limits.

cassie: Drafting final customer note: "Issue mitigated — peering provider resolved packet loss; we rerouted traffic during mitigation. Please re-enable region pinning if you had it disabled once we confirm stability in 2 hours."

maya: updating status page to "mitigated" with note: cause = upstream peering packet loss; mitigation = traffic reroute; next update in 2h for stability confirmation.

deploy-bot: Status page updated by maya.

samira: Closing incident thread for active mitigation. Will open postmortem ticket with timeline and assign to kevin/raj/maya/cassie for follow-up. If any regression, re-open.

kevin: Thanks everyone. Follow-up tasks: request permanent NAT pool increase for glasgow1, add automated alert for NAT pool exhaustion, and perf test gradual ramp scripts.

cassie: I'll send the customer advisory and update support queues.

maya: Great work. ending handoff. :thumbsup:

samira: Incident resolved -> monitoring/observability to keep an eye on glasgow1 for next 2 hours.
